company_posts.text:
Ardent (YC X26) has been a gamechanger for us developing with AI. 

Have you ever wanted a coding or testing agent to go through your product and figure its own way out, with real data, without messing everything up? 

This company does database branching so that your coding agents and testing agents can work on real or "real" data, do whatever it needs to, and conveniently throws it all away. 

The way it works under the hood is inspired by Neon DB. The short of it is that it has its master copy of your database and tracks only the diffs. Then when you're done with the branch, it throws away all the diffs and it's like nothing ever happened! 

What other tools are you using to increase your coding leverage?

Ardent (YC X26) is now officially building its own DB sandboxes

We will have full control to make the best Postgres sandboxes in the world by a mile

Compatible with any Postgres DB regardless of provider, it will enable you to clone your entire DB even at TB scale in <6s for your agents to work on

A full DB for every task with zero tradeoffs

Thank you to everyone who helped us think through our build, especially Benjamin Swerdlow, Diptanu Gon Choudhury and BinBin H.

This is gonna be awesome
